You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of freytag-forge; edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit. Never run anything billed or networked; tests are hermetic (fake providers, TestClient). Workers cannot run uv: run Python as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python ...`; first confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside this worktree. Read docs/contributor-guide.md first.

FILES YOU OWN (edit nothing else): storygame/runtime/validation.py, storygame/web_demo.py, storygame/runtime/engine.py (only to reuse a shared helper, behavior unchanged), the NEW tests/test_refusal_lines.py, and the existing tests tests/test_engine_error_line.py, tests/test_web_demo.py, tests/test_attempt_bundle.py (you MAY update an assertion there only where it encodes the old single refusal line for a narration-guard rejection; do not weaken or delete any other assertion).

GOAL. Today web_demo.py answers EVERY failed turn with the one line REJECTED_TURN_MESSAGE = "I don't understand. Can you try something else?" (the 422, both 409 and the 500 branches of the turn endpoint). That is wrong for a narration-guard rejection: the engine understood the command, and the guard is only protecting the story. Split the player-facing line into three cases.

1. Item not visible. The guard rejected a protected or not-yet-available term AND that term appears, as a whole word or phrase (case-insensitive, same regex as storygame/runtime/engine.py's typed_term check around line 350: `(?<!\w)term(?!\w)`), in the PLAYER'S OWN input. Line: "I don't see the item you're referring to."
2. Narrator reply tripped the guard. Same guard codes, but the term was not typed by the player or no term is known (the narrator introduced it). The engine has ALREADY regenerated the narration once with rejection feedback (the guard retry in engine.py around lines 330-370, `guard_retry_used`); do NOT add another retry or change that loop. This case is what remains after that one retry fails. Line: "Nothing comes of that. Try something else."
3. Everything else: unchanged, REJECTED_TURN_MESSAGE ("I don't understand. Can you try something else?"): every other ProposalValidationError code (for example ineligible_selection), RuntimeContractError (422), RuntimeStateError, NarrationProviderError paths and the unexpected-exception 500.

The guard codes are exactly the codes narration_safety.py raises for a protected or unavailable term: narration_known_term_leak, protected_narration_leak and disclosure_guard_leak (grep `code=` in storygame/runtime/narration_safety.py to confirm there are no others that carry a `term`).

IMPLEMENTATION. In storygame/runtime/validation.py add constants ITEM_NOT_VISIBLE_MESSAGE and NARRATION_RETRY_MESSAGE with exactly the strings above, keep REJECTED_TURN_MESSAGE as is, and add a pure function `rejection_message(code: str | None, term: str | None, player_input: str) -> str` implementing the three cases (a shared helper for the whole-word typed-term test is welcome; make engine.py use it only if its behavior stays byte-identical). The message must NEVER contain the term or any other story word. In storygame/web_demo.py use `rejection_message(error.code, error.term, <the original player input text of the request>)` in the ProposalValidationError branch only; keep the `X-Freytag-Rejection-Code` header, the FREYTAG_EXPOSE_PROMPT diagnostic branch, state restoration and logging exactly as they are.

TESTS. tests/test_refusal_lines.py (new) must cover: the pure function for all three cases, including a whole-word negative (term 'card' with input 'Open the discard pile.' is case 2), no term, and a non-guard code; and the HTTP endpoint through TestClient with a fake provider (copy the helper style of tests/test_engine_error_line.py) for: (a) a player who types a protected term gets the item line, 409, with the rejection-code header and unchanged state; (b) a narrator reply that leaks a term the player did not type gets the retry line; (c) ineligible_selection, a RuntimeContractError and an unexpected exception still return the generic line; (d) no response body ever contains the protected term. Update the existing assertions only as allowed above, then run the whole suite.

HOW TO VERIFY. `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q --no-cov -p no:cacheprovider tests` must pass, and ruff check / ruff format --check on the files you changed must be clean. Finish by pasting the pytest tail and listing every existing assertion you changed and why.
